QuestInfo.name: How Spiegelmann Got His Groove Back
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann's moustache is still a hideous mistake. You really have to help him out.
QuestInfo.1: The package you brought back for Spiegelmann wasn't the one he ordered.\r\nGive Spiegelmann a chance to look through the other Delivery Boxes and talk to him again.

0.0: Hey, this one's not bad. It's not the one you were supposed to order, but it looks pretty good. What do you think? No good?
0.1: One more box. Might as well take a look...

no.0: Wait, which one did I order?

1.0: This is it! The bottom half of my face is now complete!

item.0: Find it! You have to find it! Why aren't you finding it!?
